name: HubSpot Deal Stage Velocity Benchmark Calculator

parameters.content:
## HubSpot Deal Stage Velocity Benchmarks
Weekly read-only analysis of deal stage history: time in stage, stage-to-stage durations, conversion, stalled deals and bottleneck stages.

**Read-only:** nothing is written to HubSpot.
**Safe by default:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true` logs the report in *Dry-Run Telemetry* instead of posting it.

Code nodes are generated from `src/` by `npm run build`; do not edit them in n8n.

nodes.name: Weekly Schedule
nodes.notes: Mondays 07:00 in the workflow / instance timezone.

nodes.name: Load Configuration
nodes.notes: Validates every setting (fail fast) before HubSpot is called.

nodes.name: HubSpot Get Deal Pipelines
nodes.notes: Pipelines and stages (IDs, order, closed / won flags).

nodes.name: Build Deal Search
nodes.notes: Requests every stage entered/exited timestamp for deals in the look-back window.

nodes.name: HubSpot Search Deals
nodes.notes: Paginated (100 deals/page, max 100 pages; HubSpot search caps at 10,000 results).

nodes.name: Compute Velocity Benchmarks
nodes.notes: Stage dwell stats, transitions, conversion, stalled deals and bottlenecks.

nodes.name: Dry-Run Telemetry
nodes.notes: Sandbox branch: logs the report; nothing is posted.

nodes.name: Format Slack Report
nodes.notes: Block Kit message(s); returns nothing when ENABLE_SLACK=false.

nodes.name: Build Sheet Rows
nodes.notes: One row per pipeline stage; returns nothing when ENABLE_GOOGLE_SHEETS=false.

nodes.name: Google Sheets Append Benchmarks
nodes.notes: Appends one row per stage per run, building a benchmark history over time.
